title: Best beauty box subscription that I have tried!
text: I signed up through Allure in December.  The first box was good (but gifted a lot of the box).  There is no way to pause the box through Allure (so January will be my last month through Allure).  I signed up through Amazon this month (Janauary).  I received my order through Amazon 1/23, while the box directly from Allure has yet to be picked up by the carrier.  With that being said...  My January box is awesome.  I will use everything is this box!  I love how it is not all make up or skin care but a great balance of both!
label: positive
